title: Bees for the Valley
offer: The valley is full of clover and heather. Bees would love it! Have three beehives on the farm, and we will have honey all year.

steps.say: Hum, hum, hum! Three hives in the valley. Honey for us, and for mead.

fact: Heather honey is dark and strong; clover honey is light and mild.
